description: Use this only when a content or UGC creator, an educator or coach, an owner-creator or a social media manager wants to apply to Suara's partner program (https://trysuara.com/partners). It is commission-only: partners refer small businesses to Suara and earn a share of what each referred business pays: the first 20 partners get 30% every month for as long as that business keeps paying (no 12-month cap), and partners after the first 20 get 25% for 12 months per business. Social media managers can refer their current clients and businesses they can't take on; each business signs up through the partner's link. Not for a business that wants Suara for itself, and nobody can refer their own business or a business they run. Partner rules: say you earn a commission (#ad, #affiliate or the platform's paid partnership label, and in words); only say what's true about Suara, no promised results; no spam or link-drops in other businesses' comments; no paid ads on the Suara name; no coupon or deal sites; don't pretend to be Suara staff. Before calling: ask for each detail (don't guess any), then show the person everything you will send plus the rules, and call only after they explicitly confirm. Set confirmed to true only then. It sends the application to the Suara team; nothing else happens and no account is created.

agrees_to_rules.description: True only if they said they'll disclose the commission and follow the partner rules

audiences.description: Who their audience is (pick any that fit)

business.description: Their own business's Instagram or website if they'd like Suara for it, optional

channel.description: Their main channel link, e.g. instagram.com/theirname, a TikTok, YouTube, newsletter or website

confirmed.description: True only after they saw every detail above and explicitly said to send it

country.description: Where they are. 'Another country' if theirs isn't listed.

email.description: Their email, where Suara will reply

handle.description: The handle they want in their link (trysuara.com/app/start/?src=creator-<handle>): 2 to 30 lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -

how_you_will_share.description: How they'd share Suara, in their words: a reel, a newsletter, a talk, a word with clients...

name: apply_as_partner
title: Apply to Suara's partner program
